description: Decode PEM/DER X.509 certificates: subject, issuer, validity, SANs, key type/size, signature algorithm, extensions and fingerprints. Operations: "decode" — Decode every certificate in a PEM bundle (or one bare base64 DER).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: decode returns a different result on each call.

input.description: PEM text (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----) or base64 DER.

operation.description: decode — Decode every certificate in a PEM bundle (or one bare base64 DER).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: x509
title: X.509 Certificate Decoder
